articles.summary: In this blog post, we’re taking you through how we made de novo biosensors for maltose with BindCraft, explaining our computational pipeline and experimental validation. Ultimately, we prove that the combination of cutting-edge computational design and high-throughput screening can turn a biological concept into a functional tool in no time.
